title: Spot the Weaker Plan
short: Compare two study plans by checking each habit: spaced or crammed, recall or reread, mixed or blocked, rested or tired.
trouble: Picking the plan that sounds harder-working (more hours) instead of the one that uses better habits.

practice.q: Plan A: highlight the chapter for two hours the night before. Plan B: four 20-minute sessions over a week, each starting with a blank-page recall. Which is weaker, and why?
practice.a: Plan A is weaker: crammed, no recall.
steps: A is crammed and uses highlighting, not recall.
B is spaced and uses retrieval.
practice.title: Worked example

blocks.html: Two plans can take the same time and give very different results. Check each plan against four questions.
